title: Architecture Decisions
summary: Authoritative numbered decision record (ADR-001 through ADR-019) for asap-ireports, covering scope, deployment target, retrieval, orchestration framework, model gateway, and review-gate architecture.
scope: suitability (5 CFR part 731) and SEAD-4 authority routing
ASAP delivery envelope and local ASAP mock
human-review gate and disposition state machine
orchestration framework bake-off (LangGraph, Strands Agents SDK, hand-rolled Python)

notes: Manifest declared ADR; content confirms (numbered entries, explicit Status values, Context/Decision/Rationale/Consequences structure). GRANULARITY: this single file contains NINETEEN distinct decisions, ADR-001 through ADR-019, each separately numbered, dated, and status-carrying. Extract each entry as its own locked decision; do not collapse the file into one decision. All nineteen currently read Accepted, so all are locked. Relationships the synthesizer must preserve: ADR-012 (orchestration framework) moved from Open to Accepted on 2026-08-11 with the resolution LangGraph, and retains its original bake-off reasoning above the Resolution section; ADR-015 amends ADR-008; ADR-017 and ADR-018 each amend ADR-015; ADR-019 supersedes the structured-output mechanism in ADR-015 and the per-model-group diagnosis in ADR-018 while ADR-018's guard survives. PRECEDENCE: this file is self-declared authoritative for the whole project and beats blueprint.md wherever the two diverge. Several entries also carry hard prohibitions (ADR-011 no review bypass, ADR-014 no aggregate risk score) that read as binding constraints, not preferences. Open questions Q-01 through Q-05 and Q-14 are referenced but live in OPEN-QUESTIONS.md. Filename note: no hashing tool was available in this session, so the collision-avoidance suffix is the flattened source path (docs + extension) rather than a SHA-256 prefix; it is still unique per source path.
